external_games.name: That Time I Was Reincarnated as a Box that can Draw Various Lines that Interact with the Environment

name: That Time I Was Reincarnated as a Box that can Draw Various Lines that Interact with the Environment
summary:
That Time I Was Reincarnated as a Box that can Draw Various Lines that Interact with the Environment is a very normal game about being reincarnated as a box with line-drawing powers.

You draw different types of lines to move through levels and mess with the environment. Use ink to create platforms, interact with physics, spread fire, and other questionable tools to solve puzzles or accidentally create new problems.
